d: We are looking for AI Voice Recording Contributors to join an Arabic (Gulf) voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.
How Your Recordings Will Be Used

Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.
q: Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use
Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent
Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own
Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required
Strong communication skills and attention to detail
Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy
Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise
Computer microphone or headset with microphone
Ability to access and use an online recording platform
r: Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person)
Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided
Speak using your natural dialect and accent
Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered
Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards
Complete tasks using our internal recording platform
x: Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology
Access to future language and AI-related projects
A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects

Ensures clear service boundaries and escalates out-of-scope requests to the Vice President of Technology.

Security Control Operation: Implements, operates, tests and evidences security controls across the IT estate in line with the security strategy and control design owned by the Vice President of Technology. This includes identity and access management (Entra ID, conditional access, privileged identity management), privileged access management, PKI, endpoint protection, patching, hardening, vulnerability remediation and access reviews.

Audit and Compliance: Owns IT audit readiness, evidence and the timely remediation of findings against ISO/IEC 27001, 22301, and 20000 working closely with GRC and external auditors. Owns the control actions and risk treatment plans for IT risks.
IT Service Continuity: Owns IT service continuity and disaster recovery plans, testing and evidence, aligned to the Technology business continuity framework owned by the Vice President of Technology.
Infrastructure Modernisation: Plans and delivers infrastructure modernisation within the approved technology roadmap and strategy.
Design Governance: Exercises operational design autonomy within corporate technology blueprints and brings major design changes to the Vice President of Technology for review and approval.
Vendor and Licence Management: Manages IT vendors, suppliers, contracts and licensing, ensuring value for money, licence compliance and timely renewals.
Cost Optimisation: Continuously optimises cloud consumption, licensing and operating costs, tracks spend against budget and provides budget inputs and forecasts to the Vice President of Technology.

Continuous Improvement and Automation: Drives continuous improvement, automation and AI adoption within IT operations, including self-service, automated provisioning, infrastructure as code and AI-assisted support, aligned with Help AG's AI Transformation Programme.

Workplace and Facilities Technology: Owns the selection, operation and support of workplace technology, including access control, audio-visual and meeting room systems, printing, telephony and IT peripherals where required.

Incident and Escalation Management: Acts as the operational escalation point for IT incidents during and outside business hours, leads major incident response, and escalates crisis-level events to the required stakeholders where required.

Reporting: Provides regular written status reporting to the Vice President of Technology, covering KPIs, SLA attainment, service continuity, audit and control status, risks, cost and improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Partners with MSS, GRC, Software Delivery, Microsoft Platform Engineering and other business functions to ensure IT services support business objectives, and engages external auditors and vendors as required.
